WHAT WE LEARNED

Where fans stayed mattered more than distance to the stadium.

84%

of hotel guests stayed downtown, and the two businesses inside the Loop saw the biggest gains.

The bottleneck was awareness, not interest.

Half didn't know the map existed. Of those who opened it, 60% visited a business.

The show was at night. The sales were by day.

At one downtown restaurant, breakfast trays sold rose 50% and lunch trays 117%, compared with the prior four-week average.

Observed over one concert weekend. Not a controlled experiment.
